tidbit: Did you know… about 14,000 new articles reached our newsroom in the last 24 hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
A woman died after ChatGPT allegedly dispensed fatal medical advice to her. Reported by BankInfoSecurity: the incident highlights risks of relying on conversational AI for health decisions.
Anthropic targets a 1.5–2 trillion dollar IPO valuation, underscoring the artificial intelligence gap between the US and China. Reported by IndexBox: the valuation signals intensifying competition in the sector.
PhoenixAI launches NEXT QUERY 2026, a summit featuring speakers from Microsoft, NVIDIA, Apple, Coinbase and Intuit focused on artificial intelligence data infrastructure. Reported by citybiz: the event brings together production perspectives from major technology firms.
OpenAI's GPT-6.1 Terra model delivers performance comparable to Astra at one-tenth the price and completes tasks 3 times faster. Confirmed by Yahoo Tech: the model represents significant efficiency gains for users.
Verisk expands insurance data access to artificial intelligence platforms including Amazon Quick and Claude through natural-language queries. Reported by Beinsure: the integration broadens how insurers leverage conversational systems for data analysis.
Free every hour.
